question: Which Jujutsu Kaisen manga arc has more chapters, the Shibuya Incident Arc or the Shinjuku Showdown Arc? Give the chapter ranges.
answer:
**The Shibuya Incident Arc has more chapters.**

- **Shibuya Incident Arc:** Chapters 79–137, which is 59 chapters.
- **Shinjuku Showdown Arc:** Chapters 222–271, which is 50 chapters.

Source: the "Chapters" field of each arc's infobox on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki, from the local KB (https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Shibuya_Incident_Arc and https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Shinjuku_Showdown_Arc). The KB's chapter pages are tagged 58 for Shibuya and 50 for Shinjuku. I take the one-chapter gap to be a single chapter page missing from the KB, so I used the 59 from the range.

uv run /Users/enzojolivet/Code/Fandom-Skill/skills/fandom-kb/scripts/fandom_kb.py search jujutsu-kaisen "Shinjuku Showdown Arc"

uv run /Users/enzojolivet/Code/Fandom-Skill/skills/fandom-kb/scripts/fandom_kb.py sql jujutsu-kaisen "SELECT arc, COUNT(*) n, MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(title,9) AS INT)) lo, MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(title,9) AS INT)) hi FROM chapters WHERE title LIKE 'Chapter %' AND arc LIKE '%Shibuya%' OR arc LIKE '%Shinjuku%' GROUP BY arc"
